correctness.rationale: For any nonzero periodic solution, if no zero occurs then x_t−x_(t−1)=1 and all residues are visited: contradiction. Rotate so x_(N−1)=0. The nonzero mask b_j must have weight divisible by 3 and completely reconstructs x_j=Σ_(i=0)^j b_(i−k) mod3. Mask equality, exact primitivity, and nonlinear recurrence are necessary and sufficient; hence enumerating all nonzero binary masks, all 1<=N<=22 and each k modN is exhaustive for the FINITE claim. Independently implemented exact C++17 enumeration processed 176,160,517 masks, finding only (4,2),(4,3),(9,4),(9,6),(19,5),(19,15),(22,8),(22,15), with 1,1,3,3,7,7,7,7 zero-anchored words, each one cyclic orbit. This does not classify longer periods or basins.
